breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a simulation cannot be both RAS and LES. It resolved the conflict by explicitly choosing the RAS model (`kEpsilon`) and stating that the `LES` block will be removed from the `constant/turbulenceProperties` file, which is the correct procedure to resolve this error.
